text: Backend Board ￿ Epic A — User Profile & /user/me/profile Goal: Activate UserProfile, join it with UserAccount, expose GET/PUT. BE-A1 — Activate UserProfile entity • Paths: WBB/Domain/Entity/UserProfile.java (uncomment & finalize), add WBB/Repository/UserProfileRepository.java • Work: – Use @MapsId one-to-one with UserAccount (ID = user_id). – Fields: displayName, bio (<=500), location, tags (ElementCollection), mainPhoto (Photo), updatedAt. • Migrations: db/migration/V2025_08_18__create_user_profile.sql • Deps: None • AC: – Table created with FK to wbcore.user_account(user_id). – JPA saves/loads a profile linked to a user. • Tests: JPA persist/retrieve; @MapsId relationship. BE-A2 — DTOs & combined response • Paths: – WBB/Domain/DTO/UserProfileDTO.java (new) – WBB/Domain/DTO/UserWithProfileResponse.java (new) – WBB/Domain/DTO/DTOMapper.java (add mappers) • Work: Map UserAccount + UserProfile to UserWithProfileResponse. • Deps: BE-A1 • AC: Mapper round-trip compiles; null-safe. 1 BE-A3 — PUT /user/me/profile & expand GET /user/me • Paths: WBB/Controller/UserController.java, WBB/Service/UserService.java, .../Impl/UserAccountService.java • Work: – Add PUT /user/me/profile (auth): upsert profile for current user from UserProfileDTO. – Change GET /user/me to return UserWithProfileResponse (not just UserDTO). • Deps: BE-A2 • AC: iOS can save & fetch profile; validation on bio length, tags size (<=30). • Tests: Controller slice tests (MockMvc), service unit tests. BE-A4 — Onboarding step-2 activates user • Paths: WBB/Service/Impl/OnboardingServiceImpl.java • Work: When part-2 completes, set UserStatus.ACTIVE. • AC: Status flips to ACTIVE only after successful profile save. • Tests: Service test for state transition. ￿ Epic B — Activities CRUD & Participation Goal: Full lifecycle + join flow, permissions, pagination. BE-B1 — Activity DTOs & validation • Paths: WBB/Domain/DTO/activity/* (new package) – CreateActivityRequest.java, UpdateActivityRequest.java, ActivityResponse.java • Work: Bean validation (title required, maxAttendees 1–500, startTime < endTime). • AC: DTOs compile; constraints enforced with 400 on invalid input. • Tests: Validator tests. BE-B2 — ActivityController CRUD • Paths: WBB/Controller/ActivityController.java (new) • Endpts: 2 – POST /activities – GET /activities/{id} – PUT /activities/{id} (creator only) – DELETE /activities/{id} (creator only) • Notes: Ownership checks in service; return ActivityResponse. • Deps: BE-B1 • AC: CRUD works; 403 for non-creator updates/deletes. • Tests: Controller + service; negative paths (404/403). BE-B3 — Participation endpoints • Paths: WBB/Controller/ActivityController.java • Endpts: – POST /activities/{id}/join → ActivityAttendance with status REQUESTED – GET /activities/{id}/requests (creator) – POST /activities/{id}/requests/{userId} body {decision:"APPROVE"|"DENY"} • Deps: BE-B2 • AC: Multiple requests handled idempotently; capacity not exceeded when approving. • Tests: Join/approve/deny flows; capacity guard. BE-B4 — Repos & perf indices • Paths: – WBB/Repository/ActivityRepository.java (add query helpers) – WBB/Repository/ActivityAttendanceRepository.java (add find- ers) • AC: Query helpers present; indexes created. • Tests: Repository tests (Testcontainers). ￿ Epic C — Bonding Moment Goal: Create Bond + BondingMoment + notify mutuals. 3 BE-C1 — Entities for BondingMoment & Notification • Paths: – WBB/Domain/Entity/BondingMoment.java (new) – WBB/Domain/Entity/Notification.java (new) – WBB/Repository/BondingMomentRepository.java (new) – WBB/Repository/NotificationRepository.java (new) • Migrations: V2025_08_20__bonding_moment_and_notification.sql • AC: Tables created; FKs to bond, photo, user_account. • Tests: JPA mapping tests. BE-C2 — POST /bonds/moment • Paths: WBB/Controller/BondController.java (fill), WBB/Service/BondService.java, .../Impl/BondServiceImpl.java • Work: – Request DTO BondMomentRequest { userId1,userId2,photoObjectName } – In service: create Bond (dedupe pair), create BondingMoment linked to Photo, compute mutual connections, create Notification rows. • Deps: BE-C1 • AC: Returns {bondId,momentId,mutualNotified}; idempotent within 5 minutes per pair (guard). • Tests: Service mutual calc, controller E2E. ￿ Epic D — Feeds & Matching MVP Goal: Rank activities by compatibility; return moments feed. BE-D1 — MatchingService (content-based) • Paths: WBB/Service/MatchingService.java (new), .../Impl/MatchingServiceImpl.java (new) • Work: score(User a, User b) = 10*mutual + 3*sharedTags + 2*sameCity. Caffeine cache (5–10 min TTL). • Deps: BE-A1/A2, existing OnboardingAnswerRepository or tags in UserProfile. • AC: Returns deterministic scores; cache hits logged. • Tests: Weighting unit tests. 4 BE-D2 — FeedController • Paths: WBB/Controller/FeedController.java (new) • Endpts: – GET /feed/activities?page=&size= → { items:[{activity, compatScore}], nextPageToken } – GET /feed/moments?page=&size= → bonding moments (self + di- rect bonds) desc • Deps: BE-D1, BE-C1 • AC: Pagination; city filter; recent activities (<=30d). • Tests: Controller tests, pagination edges. ￿ Epic E — Moderation/Access hardening Goal: Lock moderation endpoints; audit log. BE-E1 — Verify moderation security • Paths: WBB/Config/SecurityConfig.java, WBB/Controller/ModerationController.java • Work: Confirm @PreAuthorize works with roles; add tests. • AC: 403 for non-MOD/ADMIN. • Tests: Method security test. BE-E2 — Simple audit logging • Paths: Add AuditLogger util, call in approve/reject. • AC: Action, actor, target persisted to logs (or DB if desired). ￿ Epic F — Auth/Security polish Goal: Production-grade security details. BE-F1 — Refresh token validation polish • Paths: WBB/Controller/AuthController.java, WBB/Config/TokenProvider.java • Work: Add audience/issuer checks on refresh; rotate refresh tokens. • AC: Invalid aud/iss rejected; logs sanitized. 5 BE-F2 — Rate limiting & abuse protection • Paths: WBB/Config/Bucket4jConfig.java (new filter), register in Secu- rity chain • Rules: per-IP 200 rpm; per-user 60 rpm; stricter on /auth/* • AC: 429 returned on exceed; headers include remaining. • Tests: Integration with embedded container. BE-F3 — Actuator health + Swagger • Paths: Add Spring Boot Actuator; OpenAPI/Swagger config. • Security: Expose /actuator/health public; others secured. • AC: Health green in Cloud Run; Swagger at /swagger-ui. • Tests: Smoke test. ￿ Epic G — Photos pipeline hardening Goal: Safer upload/complete flow. BE-G1 — File validation & signed URL context • Paths: WBB/Service/FileValidationService.java (exists), .../PhotoServiceImpl.java, WBB/Controller/PhotoController.java • Work: Enforce MIME allowlist, max size, and context enum (PROFILE, ACTIVITY, BOND_MOMENT). • AC: Bad inputs rejected with 400; ownerType stored correctly. • Tests: Unit tests for validation. ￿ Epic H — Ops/Deploy/Observability Goal: Cloud Run prod readiness. BE-H1 — Flyway + Testcontainers • Paths: Add Flyway config; create all migrations above. Add Testcontain- ers for Postgres in integration tests. • AC: App starts with clean DB; tests spin ephemeral Postgres. • Tests: Migration validation CI step. 6 BE-H2 — Cloud Run config & secrets • Paths: cloudbuild.yaml or GH Actions; application-prod.yml • Work: Secret Manager for JWT, Twilio, GCS; min instances, mem- ory/CPU; HikariCP tuning. • AC: Staging+Prod services up; /actuator/health OK; logs structured. BE-H3 — Metrics, tracing, logging hygiene • Paths: Add Micrometer → GCP; mask PII in logs; correlation IDs. • AC: p95 latency exported per endpoint; no secrets in logs. ￿ Dependencies Map • BE-A1 → A2 → A3 (entity → DTO → endpoints) • BE-B1 → B2 → B3 (DTO → CRUD → join) • BE-C1 → C2 (entities → controller/service) • BE-A1/A2 & C1 → D1 → D2 (profiles+moments → matching → feeds) • H1 (Flyway) unblocks all schema work. ￿ Test Plan (Backend) • Unit: DTO validation; Matching weights; Photo validation. • Repo/IT (Testcontainers): Activity & Attendance; Bond mutuals; Feed queries. • Controller (MockMvc): All endpoints 200/400/403/404; pagination; auth required. • Perf (local): /feed/activities p95 < 250ms with 10k activities (seed script). ￿ PR Checklist (each ticket) Migrations created & idempotent Controller + Service + Repo code + DTOs Validation & error responses match HttpResponse format Unit/IT tests added and green Logs contain no PII/secrets 7 Swagger updated; examples added Postman/Insomnia collection updated 8
